bridge camera to lid with standoffs/bracket (dashed)

vcgencmd measure_temp in full Florida sun
(c) Battery box cutaway: Attwood 9067-1 vented Group 27 box + strap [9]: $26.00 (1 in = 22 px)
Replaces doc's NOCO Group 24 · outside 16-7/8 × 9-5/8 × 10-7/8 in · inside ≈ 13-7/8 × 7-1/4 × 10-1/2 in · four 0.55 in cable openings
[5a] Redodo 12 V 50 Ah LiFePO4, 640 Wh, 50 A BMS: $185.99 · 7.68 × 6.54 × 6.77 in, ~11–12 lb (alt. ExpertPower)
[6b] Anyongora 12 AWG waterproof inline ATC fuse holder: $7.99/4 · 5 A blade near battery + (load ≈ 0.3 A)
[7] DROK 8–100 V 20 A meter, built-in shunt (89.6 × 49.6 mm, blue LCD): $16.99 · AFTER the fuse, kept inside this box
(!) Wire DROK per its own diagram; built-in-shunt models often route current through the meter's negative leads
Fit check: 6.2 in spare length beside battery for fuse + meter; 3.7 in headroom above terminals
Doc 5a: "50 Ah is marginal for 7 days of continuous running" → see (d)
≈ 5 h bulk (50 Ah ÷ 10 A) + CV taper ≈ 6 h empty→full
Drill ABS walls at low speed, test-fit each step
(d) Power and data flow, energy budget, capture schedule
12–13.4 V in at the buck · 5.0 V out over USB-C
Pi 5 headless idle measured 2.6–3.0 W; budget 3.0 W at 5 V incl. fan, camera, capture bursts
÷ ~90 % buck efficiency → ≈ 3.3 W at 12 V (≈ 0.26 A)
Mode A, 24/7: 3.3 W × 24 h ≈ 80 Wh/day → 640 Wh ≈ 8 days (≈ 7 days keeping 10 % reserve)
Mode B, daylight only (halt after sunset; RTC wake 30 min pre-dawn; EEPROM POWER_OFF_ON_HALT=1):
3.3 W × ~12.5 h ≈ 41 Wh + standby ≈ 45 Wh/day → ≈ 13–14 days
Matches doc 5a ("50 Ah is marginal for 7 days continuous"). Swap every 7 d (A) or 10 d (B)
(!) Without POWER_OFF_ON_HALT=1, a "halted" Pi 5 still drew 1.7 W in one review
1 RGB still / 5 min, from ~30 min before sunrise to sunset → SD card
12 MP JPEG ≈ 3–6 MB (est.) → ≈ 0.4–0.8 GB/day → 128 GB ≈ 5+ months
Bench-test 24 h with the DROK, then re-plan swaps from the measured Wh/day

Geometry reference (lens = post top − 151 mm; crowns on a 10 in bed; Camera Module 3 standard: 66° H × 41° V, 4608 × 2592 px)
CHOSEN: 8 ft post driven 2.5 ft: top 5.5 ft, lens 5.0 ft, 1.27 m to crowns → 1.65 × 0.95 m, 0.36 mm/px · whole block fits, ~3 in margin per side
7 ft driven 2 ft: top 5.0 ft, lens 4.5 ft, 1.12 m → 1.45 × 0.84 m, 0.32 mm/px · 6-1/2 ft driven 2 ft (as ordered): lens 4.0 ft → 1.26 × 0.72 m, clips >16 in canopies
Guy lines: 1 north + 2 along the furrow from the post top, staked 3–4 ft out · post in the NORTH furrow so noon shadows (sun 39–48° up, Nov–Feb) fall away from the plants
4-plant block: 2 rows 12 in apart × 12–15 in in-row, 12–18 in canopies ≈ 0.7–0.85 m along × 0.61–0.76 m across. Long (66°) axis runs along the row.
Gland holes: PG7 12.5 mm → 1/2 in · PG9 15.2 mm → 5/8 in · PG11 18.6 mm → 3/4 in · M12 vent → 1/2 in. Clamp: PG7 3–6.5 mm, PG9 4–8 mm, PG11 5–10 mm.
